summary: This directory provides utility functionality focused on resolving and formatting module specifiers for the application. It serves as a centralized location for logic concerning how module paths are referenced and converted within the codebase.
responsibilities: Convert source file paths into valid module specifiers
relationships: Source paths are processed to generate standardized module specifiers for internal consistency.
designDecisions: Centralization of path-to-module logic to ensure consistency across the project
Unit testing to validate path transformation accuracy
